gloss: losing record; more losses than wins

definitions.gloss: losing record; more losses than wins
definitions.explanation: Finishing a tournament, series or season with more losses than wins. In sumo it means seven or fewer wins out of fifteen, which usually brings demotion in the rankings.

examples.japanese: {今場所|こんばしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{負|ま}け{越|こ}しだ。
examples.english: He has a losing record this tournament.

examples.japanese: {負|ま}け{越|こ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: He is now certain to finish with a losing record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大関|おおぜき}→大関：12662_oozeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二場所|ふたばしょ}{続|つづ}けて{負|ま}け{越|こ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{関脇|せきわけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: An ozeki who has losing records in two tournaments in a row drops to sekiwake.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {負|ま}け{越|こ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: a losing record is settled
- {負|ま}け{越|こ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to end with a losing record
- ⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧ぶり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{負|ま}け{越|こ}し: the first losing record in three years

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勝|か}ち{越|こ}し→勝ち越し：21883_kachikoshi⟧: winning record, the opposite
- ⟦{負|ま}け{越|こ}す→負け越す：32271_makekosu⟧: the verb, to finish with more losses than wins
